title: 先筛选CBAM范围再收集排放资料
summary_zh: CBAM正式阶段自2026年开始，覆盖特定行业的选定商品；需要按商品编码、进口人及相关数量条件核查，不能对所有欧盟订单统一加收碳成本。
summary_en: The definitive CBAM regime applies from 2026 to selected goods in listed sectors. Product coverage, importer conditions and applicable thresholds must be checked before calculating any certificate exposure.
tradex_workflow: Screen product coverage, then ask the importer or supplier for the applicable emissions evidence and current requirements.
cash_effect: Only include a documented, attributable carbon-cost scenario; do not assign a generic surcharge.
title_en: Screening CBAM scope before collecting emissions data

The definitive CBAM regime applies from 2026 to selected goods in listed sectors. Product coverage, importer conditions and applicable thresholds must be checked before calculating any certificate exposure.
